This replacement keeps only the fixed trigger/dependency source link from lesson 2c16a420bd7e9b4695a38b218518bbd1b0f359002413d44970a76e2bf40a1037: at 0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, nsMsgAccountManager::Init starts this Panorama service inside MOZ_PANORAMA and mail_panorama_enabled_AtStartup(), after factory registration and service lookup. DatabaseCore::Startup calls EnsureConnection and returns its failure before allocating folder/message tables. Startup is synchronous here; the historical Promise readiness contract does not apply. Existing startup/rejection lessons remain the reusable guidance. These are exact static source facts, with no reproduced startup failure, full ownership graph or runtime test.
